requirements.name: 38 US City Real GIS Dataset Coverage & Interstate Connectivity

MultiRegionStreamer LRU eviction and PlanetaryOriginCoordinator floating origin stability verified over thousand-kilometer trajectories.

requirements.name: Cryptographic Package Integrity (SHA-256)

requirements.name: Asynchronous Chunk Streaming & LRU Cache

requirements.name: Rapier3D Physics & Terrain Collision

requirements.name: Drivable Car Physics & Complete Driving Experience
requirements.notes: Stage 4 Complete: 6 detailed vehicle garage models with interior cockpits (animated steering wheel, dashboard, seats), dynamic headlights/brake/reverse lights, Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) preventing barrier tunneling, anti-roll bar (ARB) torsional roll suppression, motionless hill-hold on 22% grades, reverse mode with speed governor, safe upright recovery, speed-sensitive steering attenuation, 4 camera perspectives (Chase, Hood, Cockpit, Bumper), and driving HUD telemetry.

requirements.name: Complete Multimodal Transportation Integration (Road, Rail, Marine, Aviation)
requirements.notes: Stage 7 Complete: Fully integrated motorcycle 2-wheel lean dynamics and camber thrust; transit bus passenger payload scaling (12.5T to 18.1T), air brakes, and swept-path rear overhang; heavy truck fifth-wheel kingpin trailer articulation, jackknife limits, and static rollover threshold (a_crit = 5.70 m/s^2 = 0.58g); road access restrictions (BRT, freight bans, motorcycle corridors); railway consist Davis resistance (quadratic aerodynamic growth), Westinghouse air brake pipe pressure venting, wheel-slip adhesion limits, Caltrain corridor navigation, turnout switches, and ATP stop signal emergency tripping; marine vessel Archimedes buoyancy draft equilibrium, metacentric righting stability (GM = 1.8m > 0), wave heave, rudder turning, SF Bay fairway channels, berth docking deceleration, and bathymetric shoreline grounding; aviation 6-DOF aerodynamic polar, barometric density lapse, ground effect, post-stall separation (>15 deg), oleo struts, SFO Runway 28L takeoff roll, Vr rotation, ILS approach guidance, and touchdown dynamics; 12 domain acoustic events (MultimodalAudioEvent); multimodal career mission lifecycle contracts with boundary enforcement. Verified across 13 comprehensive E2E certification tests in stage7_multimodal_transport_certification.rs. Seamless interactive viewer mode switching ([M], [1-7]), dedicated 3D fleet meshes, and dedicated cockpit HUD telemetry clusters across all 7 modes. Simulation throughput: 261,465 Hz (3.82 µs/step).

requirements.name: Road Network Graph, Grade Separation & Turn-by-Turn Navigation
requirements.notes: Stage 5 Complete: Source-grounded, chunk-connected routing graph with grade-separated layer isolation (layer 0 ground vs layer 1 flyovers), one-way edges, turn restrictions, A* shortest/fastest routing, wrong-way detection (>105° heading delta), off-route alerts (>35m cross-track error), and turn-by-turn guidance with 2D HUD banner.

requirements.name: Autonomous Traffic Simulation, Signals & Pedestrian Activity
requirements.notes: Stage 5 Complete: Autonomous AI traffic simulation using Intelligent Driver Model (IDM) car-following, 3-phase intersection traffic lights (Green/Amber/Red) with stop lines, multilane MOBIL gap acceptance with smooth lateral interpolation, 2D spatial hash grid O(1) partitioning (>60 FPS with >=64 vehicles), gridlock unstick recovery (>20s), horn audio telemetry, 3D animated traffic signals with illuminated lenses, roadside signs (Stop/SpeedLimit/OneWay), and procedural 3D pedestrians on crosswalks.

requirements.name: Cross-Platform WGPU Rendering Engine

requirements.name: High-Fidelity PBR Shading, Metric Façades, Roads & Atmosphere

requirements.name: Interactive Desktop Windowing & Live Surface

requirements.name: Realistic Framerate Metrics vs Headless Spurious FPS

requirements.name: Multi-Career Mission Loop & Real-Road Career Contracts (Taxi, Courier, Freight, Free Roam)
requirements.notes: Stage 6 Complete: Urban Taxi & Chauffeur, Express Courier & Delivery, Intercity Freight Logistics, and Free Roam across 38 US cities. Physical vehicle stop detection (< 2.0 km/h) and 2.0s dwell loading/unloading enforced. Passenger comfort tips, high-G collision penalties, time-limit speed bonuses, and reputation tier gating (Novice, Professional, Expert, Master) fully certified with 100% pass rate in stage6_user_experience_gameplay_certification.rs.

requirements.name: Game Persistence (F5 Quicksave / F9 Quickload) & Schema Migration

requirements.name: Authoritative Server & Client Prediction Protocol
requirements.notes: Stage 9 Complete: Fully integrated optional headless authoritative Rust server (UdpSocketTransport) with 60 Hz tick loop, token-bucket rate limiter, binary packet protocol, and authenticated sessions. Production multiplayer client (MultiplayerClient) connected to world-viewer and world-cli with zero-latency prediction, rewind-and-replay reconciliation (verified 0.0000m divergence), remote interpolation (80ms jitter buffer, 0 teleport artifacts), 2D grid AoI spatial culling (>85% bandwidth reduction), floating origin invariance, in-game glassmorphic lobby modal ([N]/[F4]), status chip, remote vehicle fleet mesh rendering, and offline single-player zero overhead (64.7µs over 10,000 cycles). Certified across 8 E2E tests in stage9_authoritative_multiplayer_certification.rs.
